product_one_liner.value: Auterion provides a vendor-independent operating system and autonomy platform that lets defense, government and commercial operators deploy and coordinate fleets of drones and other autonomous vehicles.

pricing_page.notes: The Suite product page publicly lists Basic, Pro and Enterprise plans and prices.

named_customers.notes: The announcement explicitly includes both companies in Auterion’s global customer base.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 205 employees and a 201–500 company-size band.

hq_location.notes: Auterion also has a European headquarters in Munich, Germany.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical implementation posts: GPS-denied navigation by Computer Vision Engineer Kamil Ritz, and collision prevention by Software Engineer Tanja Bauman and Autonomy Lead Julian Kent.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Computer Vision Engineer is an open qualifying role.

model_provider.notes: Auterion publicly offers Spleenlab’s machine-learning perception software for installation on its AI Node. This is an onboard integration, not evidence of a hosted LLM provider or use across every Auterion product.

compliance_certs.notes: The documents name GDPR and GDPR-compliant safeguards; GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim, not an independently awarded certification. No completed SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA or PCI DSS certification was established.

last_funding.notes: Rheinmetall’s investment was announced November 18, 2025; its amount was not disclosed. The earlier September 23, 2025 Series B announcement reported $130 million, including $25 million in non-dilutive financing. A June 2026 UK research-program award is not treated as an investment round.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 23, 2025 Series B falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The November 9, 2026 snapshot lists 25 openings, with no SDR, BDR or Account Executive titles. Mission Coordinator and Solutions Engineer do not qualify.

launched_6mo.notes: Auterion introduced the Nemyx Vertical Launch System on October 5, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Kiran Hebbar announced his new role as Auterion CFO on February 4, 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The RevOps posting explicitly describes ownership of HubSpot, its NetSuite integration, and data-quality automation using n8n and Clay. Salesforce is mentioned only as desirable experience, so it is not listed as confirmed usage.
